title: ANTAR — Assessment of Niche, Treeline & Analogue Refugia
description: ANTAR is a hybrid process-statistical framework for finding where climate-resilient forest restoration will hold in Armenia: a daily water balance, a mechanistic hydraulic-failure hazard, a statistical dieback hazard, species niches and the climatic treeline, viability and robust refugia under 45 climate scenarios, and a budget-constrained, scenario-robust planting portfolio. Source code, fitted results, tests and the documentation of what is and is not modelled. The interactive results are at https://antar.narekohanyan.com.
